text: In 1933, the National Socialists placed Franz Kafka, author of The Trial, on their list of banned authors and publicly burned his works. The Trial had been published in 1925. In Argentina, a military junta banned the novel as subversive literature in 1976.
meta_description: The Trial by Franz Kafka: Kafka placed on the Nazi list of banned authors in 1933 and his works burned; banned by Argentina's military junta in 1976.
